text:
anita: hey team — last-minute heads up: my family is celebrating a religious festival next friday (will need the morning off). sprint has a release that day, can i swap a floating holiday or do a half-day and mark coverage? cc @jake for approvals :pray:
people-ops-bot: FYI payroll cutoff for time off changes this pay period is 3 business days before period end. see https://hr.redwood.com/timeoff (automated reminder) :calendar:
mina: thanks for flagging, @anita. short checklist: 1) submit a time-off request in the portal indicating "half-day - religious observance" 2) pick a coverage owner and confirm with manager 3) if this is within blackout window you need manager + people-ops approval. i can fast-track once you post the request. :+1:
jake: got it, @anita — happy to cover release oversight in the morning. can you update the PR handoff note and ping me 24h before? also add the half-day in the portal so payroll sees it.
anita: filing request now. question: will this count against carryover or float allowance? i have 6 floating hols and 3 PTO carryover left.
luis: curious about that too — does half-day eat a floating holiday or PTO bucket? manager told me different things before.
sara: policy excerpt: "Floating holidays are consumed before PTO carryover for observed religious events unless employee elects otherwise at request time." link: <https://hr.redwood.com/policies/holidays> so you can choose which bucket when submitting, but note payroll cutoffs.
mina: correct — when you submit, there's a dropdown: "Use floating holiday" or "Use PTO". if you want us to preserve carryover, select floating. if you accidentally pick PTO we can adjust before payroll cutoff. i'll monitor the request and post approval once @jake confirms coverage.
anita: thanks! submitted as floating holiday and added a short handoff in the release doc. pinged @jake to confirm. :sparkles:
jake: confirmed coverage and approved the request in portal. @mina thanks for helping fast-track.
people-ops-bot: people-ops notifications: request 2790012345-1 was approved by manager jake. note: payroll change window ends in 2 business days.
mina: all set, @anita — i updated the HR side to mark this as a religious observance swap and preserved your carryover. enjoy the festival :)
anita: appreciate everyone, thank you! :heart:
